description:
Justice born from evil, malice born from evil.

Chae Jeong-Eun, on the verge of revenge against Kim Young-Jin, the man who had driven her mother's death and her own life into darkness, is left with no hope of achieving her goal. Her life is shattered by Young-jin's rise to power. Losing all motivation, she wanders the streets, ultimately contemplating death. Then comes the phone call from Kim Do-Gi. At Do-Gi's suggestion, Jeong-Eun joins Rainbow Taxi. After six months of training as a recall driver, she takes on the role of intern and works alongside him on recalls. Will Jeong-Eun successfully complete her internship and be hired as a full-time driver? And will Do-Gi and Jeong-Eun emerge victorious in this showdown with absolute evil? It's time to board the Model Taxi again!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
